findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "streamable" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ground_citation, construction_events, nl_municipal_build_rules, check_material, order_materials, estimate_case_create, estimate_case_video, fetch · Private data: check_counterparty_nl, record_counterparty_check, ground_astranl, ground_component, ground_citation, check_material, check_estimate_materials, order_materials, estimate_case_create, estimate_case_status, estimate_case_answer, estimate_case_files, estimate_case_video, commitment_attest, housing_need, fetch · Public sink: estimate_case_create, estimate_case_answer, estimate_case_files, estimate_case_video, commitment_attest, fetch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ground_citation, construction_events, nl_municipal_build_rules, check_material, order_materials, estimate_case_create, estimate_case_video, fetch · Private data: check_counterparty_nl, record_counterparty_check, ground_astranl, ground_component, ground_citation, check_material, check_estimate_materials, order_materials, estimate_case_create, estimate_case_status, estimate_case_answer, estimate_case_files, estimate_case_video, commitment_attest, housing_need, fetch · Public sink: estimate_case_create, estimate_case_answer, estimate_case_files, estimate_case_video, commitment_attest, fetch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
